# Every use of `unsafe` outside comments in every Rust file in the repository, counted as uses,
# not lines, by file. CI counts them on every change and fails when the counts differ from this
# list, so new `unsafe` can't land without someone updating this file in the same pull request,
# where review sees it. Each is explained where it is; the two in the self-host tests are the
# word in test programs, and the one in the lexer is the word in its list of reserved words. The
# runtime's `TerminateProcess` declaration and call end a program on Windows without the C
# runtime's `exit`, which crashed workers still starting. mimalloc's `mi_register_error`
# declared and called give mimalloc an error handler, so running out of memory is said in
# Fennec's words with the program's output kept, not in Rust's with a core dump. Its two newest,
# glibc's `mallopt` declared and called on Linux with glibc, keep glibc's allocator to one arena:
# a thread's own arena reserves 64 MiB at once, and a program short of address space then had
# glibc abort registering a thread's destructors rather than Fennec say it ran out.
crates/fennec/tests/selfhost.rs: 2
crates/parked/src/current.rs: 1
crates/runtime/src/lib.rs: 12
crates/syntax/src/token.rs: 1
